description: Given a shared total and who already paid what, compute each player's balance and the minimal set of payments (who pays whom, how much) to settle everyone. Use when the question is 'who owes whom'. For recurring sessions with different attendees use split_series.

currency.description: Currency code used only for display, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP (default USD)

participants.description: At least 2 players with unique names; include 'paid' for anyone who already paid, e.g. [{"name":"Asha","paid":96},{"name":"Dev"}]

name.description: Player name, unique within the list, e.g. 'Asha'

paid.description: Amount this player already paid toward the total, in currency units (default 0)

shares.description: Optional positive relative weights, one per participant in the same order, e.g. [2,1,1]; omit for an equal split

total_cost.description: Total court/venue cost in currency units, e.g. 96 for $96.00

name: settle_up

balances.description: Per-player paid, owed share and net balance

balance.description: paid minus owed; positive = gets money back, negative = owes money

owed.description: This player's fair share of the cost

total_cost.description: Total shared cost, rounded to cents

transfers.description: Minimal list of payments that settles the group

amount.description: Amount to transfer, rounded to cents

title: Settle up
